review_method: Each of the eight original PNG files was opened individually with tools.view_image. Candidate PNGs are logical 930 x 1240 at 1x; references are physical 1860 x 2480 at 2x and were compared at equivalent logical proportions. Get-FileHash SHA256 was applied directly to unmodified original PNG bytes.

identity_verification.reference_set_hash_scope: The provided reference-set identity is recorded as supplied; the four individual reference PNG hashes were independently compared with their case metadata. The aggregate reference-set digest was not recomputed.

observations: The separate source manager retains the Browse back label, large serif title, installed/available counts, source-list and add-source actions, and the five-item dock with Browse selected.

The vertical separator is at logical x=400. The seven installed sources stay in the left column, while the right column displays ten source rows with a separate 1/13 folio and next-page control near the bottom. No left-column pagination is introduced.

Primary names, bold actions, subdued metadata, thin dividers, monochrome source badges, and generous white space preserve the reference hierarchy. Buttons and pagination remain visibly inside the viewport.

The unavailable source B subtitle is ellipsized around logical x=100..286, y=754, after the Kindle wording. Its final unavailable status is hidden. This shared installed-column issue is tracked as P3R1-REF31-2.
intentional_differences: Available-source records are the actual captured fixture records, including MangaDex, source A, and numbered demonstration sources, instead of the reference's illustrative C-L records. Counts, languages, and versions are compared as real data rather than required literal copy.
The local-file subtitle lacks the illustrative reference book count; this does not change the required source-manager geometry.

observations: The add-source float has logical bounds approximately x=115, y=250, width=700, height=460, matching the required declared width and top position.

The float uses an opaque white surface and simple black outline without shadow, stipple, or background dimming. Its title, close action, 200-pixel QR area, endpoint region, separator, direct URL field, and keyboard-input action are fully visible.

The candidate displays a concrete HTTP endpoint, a pairing code, and a waiting-for-connection status. The case sidecar declares pairing_endpoint_running=true, modal=pairing, and modal_context=pairing. The screenshot does not claim successful connection.
The additional pairing-code line explains the small vertical redistribution beside the QR without changing the required float geometry or hiding controls.
The shared installed-column truncation remains visible below the float and is tracked once as P3R1-REF31-2.
intentional_differences: The concrete endpoint and QR differ from the reference's illustrative address and QR artwork. Only the application's declared actual pairing endpoint is acceptable; this review does not require the illustrative address or QR pattern.
The case metadata explicitly permits only the application's actual local pairing endpoint to produce a URL or QR and keeps external installation explicit.
Source names, languages, versions, and available-source records retain the actual captured data.

observations: The source-list float starts at logical x=115, y=250 and is 700 pixels wide, preserving the required geometry. Its white background and black border have no shadow or stipple.

The serif title, black Done action, neutral empty-state message, and dashed add-source-list action are clear and fully within the float. The source-manager back label and dock remain visible behind it.

The sidecar records modal=choices, modal_context=repository-list, and empty modal_items/modal_item_ids. The neutral empty state is consistent with those saved records; inventing the reference's example subscription or a remove action would be misleading.
The float naturally ends near logical y=509 because there are no subscription rows. This content-driven height is acceptable while width and top remain fixed.
The shared installed-column truncation remains visible below the float and is tracked once as P3R1-REF31-2.
intentional_differences: The reference shows an illustrative saved source-list record and Remove action. The candidate has no saved records and truthfully shows an empty state plus the Add Source List action.
The case metadata explicitly states that repository names and counts are actual saved records and empty data must not be replaced with fictional subscriptions.
Source names, languages, versions, and available-source records retain the actual captured data.

observations: The 400-pixel installed column remains intact, including all seven sources. The right Updates tab is selected, two real updatable sources are shown, each row has an Update action, and a full-width black Update All action appears below the rows.
The right-column row geometry and bulk-action position closely preserve the reference. No irrelevant ten-row pager appears when there is only one update page, and the dock stays visible.

The right update rows display only target-version subtitles: MangaDex has the language plus v13, and source A has the language plus v9. The reference explicitly shows v12 to v13 and v8 to v9 in those rows. The sidecar independently contains installed v12/v8 and available v13/v9, so both truthful endpoints are available. This is P3R1-REF31-1.

Unlike a missing-target presentation, this Scribe capture does show the available target versions. The defect is the omitted installed-to-available transition inside each update row; installed versions are visible separately in the left column.
The shared installed-column truncation also remains present and is tracked once as P3R1-REF31-2.
intentional_differences: Source names and version numbers may follow actual data. Such data differences do not justify omitting either end of the installed-to-available version transition.

suggestions.description: Show the installed-to-available version transition in each Scribe update row.
suggestions.evidence: At logical approximately x=500, y=322 and y=390, the candidate update rows show the target subtitles containing v13 and v9 only. The reference rows show v12 to v13 and v8 to v9. The exact case sidecar records installed_sources MangaDex v12 and source A v8, while available_sources records v13 and v9. The installed column supplies old versions separately but does not restore the missing transition in the update rows.
suggestions.recommendation: Build the update-row subtitle from the matching installed and available source records and display both versions with an arrow, such as v12 -> v13 and v8 -> v9, while preserving the installed column and current update controls.

suggestions.description: Keep the explicit unavailable status visible in the narrow installed-source row.
suggestions.evidence: The unavailable source B row near logical y=740..765 renders a long human-verification subtitle and ellipsizes after the Kindle wording before its final unavailable status. The case sidecar gives available=false and a subtitle ending with the unavailable message. The reference keeps a concise verification reason plus an explicit unavailable status visible. The same row is visible in all four cases.
suggestions.recommendation: Use a concise status summary or place the unavailable status before the potentially truncated explanation so the 400-pixel installed column retains the explicit status beside the warning icon and Uninstall action.

limitations: This review covers only the four listed Scribe source-manager reference pairs and does not establish that the full round is clean.

Only existing JSON and original PNG evidence was read, and only PNG hashing and individual tools.view_image inspection were performed. No application, build, tests, runtime probes, Git operations, or product edits were run.
Static screenshots establish visual placement and clipping, not interaction behavior, focus handling, pagination behavior after activation, source installation, or update completion.

The add-source sidecar declares a running pairing endpoint and the screenshot shows a waiting state. Live endpoint reachability and the QR payload were not independently exercised or decoded within this read-only visual-review scope.

Reference images were displayed by tools.view_image at a reduced presentation size; comparisons used the documented 2x physical-to-logical proportion. No transformed image was substituted for the hashed original evidence.
The source-list fixture is empty, so populated-record removal and multi-page source-list layout cannot be assessed from this batch.
